product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach Digital Electric Food Steamer & Rice Cooker for Quick, Healthy Cooking with Stackable Three-Tier Bowls for Vegetables and Seafood, 8.25 Quart, Black & Stainless Steel
features: EASILY STEAM HEALTHY VEGETABLES, SEAFOOD, MEAT AND MORE: With this electric food steamer, you can fill your plate with nutrient-rich foods. Since steaming requires no butter or oil, you can add flavor with seasonings and herbs without the extra fat.

VERSATILE, STACKABLE 3-TIER CLEAR BOWLS: Use 1 bowl for small quantities, stack 2 or 3 tiers to steam a whole 8.25 qt. meal at once, remove the bottom dividers between bowls to vertically stack taller food such as corn-on-the-cob.

EASY-TO-USE DIGITAL TOUCHPAD: Press the up and down arrows to set the cooking time. When food is ready, it beeps and switches to keep warm for 1 hour. Delay start lets you fill the steamer in advance and begin steaming up to 24 hours later.

PERFECT FOR COOKING EGGS AND RICE: This automatic food steamer lets you cook up to 24 eggs from soft to hard-boiled or prepare white or brown rice. The rice bowl is perfect for preparing up to 6.5 cups of cooked rice or small foods.
NESTED STORAGE: The 3 clear bowls of this digital food steamer nest compactly inside each other for space-saving storage.
description: Steam delicious, nutritious meals with the Hamilton Beach® 3-Tier Digital Food Steamer. Fill the clear bowls with your choice of vegetables, seafood or meat and set the cooking timer. When your food is ready, the steamer beeps and switches to warm.
